metrics.title: Policy denial rate
metrics.denominator: all eligible ai.policy.evaluated events with a known policy version
limitations: Measures recorded evaluations only; does not prove every action was evaluated.

metrics.title: Accuracy against adjudicated labels
metrics.numerator: eligible ai.run.completed events whose result.predictedLabel equals a linked ai.outcome.adjudicated label
metrics.denominator: eligible run events with exactly one compatible human-adjudication or calibrated-measurement label
limitations: A label is only as reliable as its rubric and adjudicator.
Unlabelled and pending cases are excluded and counted separately.
Comparisons require matched or appropriately adjusted cohorts.

metrics.title: Observed configuration mismatch rate
metrics.numerator: ai.runtime.config-observed events where model.approvedConfigDigest differs from model.observedConfigDigest
metrics.denominator: ai.runtime.config-observed events with both approved and observed digests
limitations: Strength depends on observation source; agent self-report is not independent runtime evidence.
A recorded match does not prove the monitor observed the complete runtime.

metrics.title: Monitor heartbeat coverage
metrics.numerator: expected monitor heartbeat intervals with a signed observation received within the configured grace period
metrics.denominator: expected intervals from the tenant's registered monitor inventory
limitations: Requires a separately maintained expected-source inventory; absence of an event alone cannot establish a monitor is installed.
